audience.recommended_interpretation: Prioritize creators near the cohort median or within the interquartile range; smaller audiences improve barter feasibility while larger audiences may increase reach and cost.

formats.ideal: Consistent short-form video with enough caption, mention, tag, or marketplace evidence to demonstrate native product integration.

ideal_creator_profile.selection_principle: Use the score as a transparent shortlist aid, then visually review content quality, brand safety, audience geography, authenticity, and commercial terms.
